column2: Take regional trains RE8, RB23, or RE7 to Bahnhof Berlin Friedrichstraße. Transfer to underground line U6 (direction Alt-Tegel) and exit at U Naturkundemuseum (2 stops).
Take the FEX to Gesundbrunnen. Transfer to S-Bahn lines S2, S25, or S26 (southbound) to Berlin Nordbahnhof, followed by a 5-minute walk.
